name: Candlelight: The Best of ABBA
description: A string quartet plays ABBA's best-known songs by candlelight at Hilton Porto Gaia on 8 November at 18:30. Tickets from €16.50.
longDescription:
Candlelight concerts are live performances held in a space lit by candles. This one is a tribute concert: a string quartet plays the music of ABBA at Hilton Porto Gaia. It has no affiliation with the band.

The programme includes Dancing Queen, SOS, Money, Money, Money, The Winner Takes It All, Waterloo, Fernando, Chiquitita, Super Trouper and Mamma Mia. The concert lasts 60 minutes.

The concert is at Hilton Porto Gaia in Vila Nova de Gaia on Sunday 8 November 2026 at 18:30. Doors open 30 minutes before the start and close 5 minutes before it begins. Seats are given out on arrival, first come first served, based on your ticket type. It's open to ages 8 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult. The venue is accessible for people with reduced mobility. Tickets from €16.50.
